A: Random
B: Systematic
C: Stratified
D: None of the above
[Answer] To draw a sample of 100 students from 1000 students, stratified sampling should be used. Stratified sampling is a method of sampling in which the population is divided into subgroups (strata) and a sample is drawn from each subgroup. In this case, the students are divided into three strata: first grade, second grade, and third grade. Stratified sampling ensures that the sample is representative of the entire population. The answer is C.
